_comment: Weekly-chartable rate history behind the 'Market history' page. Two blocks, both US dollars per GPU-hour.
silicon_index: Silicon Data's daily rental-price indices. Each run of update.py reads the public chart page behind every
index (portal.silicondata.com/gpu-index-chart?standalone=true&gpu=<gpu>&mainTab=<tab>), which carries the last seven daily
values, and merges the new dates into 'values'. 'stated' holds older points quoted in Silicon Data's own monthly index posts
(single source: the index publisher), drawn as hollow markers. B200 is the only Blackwell index; H100 (neo-cloud, the Bloomberg
SDH100RT series) and H200 are the Hopper indices; the H100 hyperscaler reading is kept for the spread.

ornn_index: Ornn's Compute Price Index (OCPI) from its public keyless API, which serves the trailing three months of daily settled values; each run merges the new dates in so the file keeps the full series. Transacted rates, volume-weighted; B200, H200 and H100 SXM.

token_index: Silicon Data's LLM Token Expenditure Index family (broad SDLLMTK, open-weight, proprietary), USD per million tokens usage-weighted, from the public chart page per series (seven daily values per read), merged the same way.
getdeploying_index: GetDeploying's public GPU price dataset (CC-BY-4.0, getdeploying.com/dataset/gpu-prices/<gpu>.json): for each week
since the GPU was listed, the median of each provider's median price and the number of providers, by billing type (B300 and
B200 on-demand and spot, GB200 on-demand). An aggregator reference reaching back to November 2025; not an input.
quotes: one series per published rental quote in data/rental_rates.json (every vendor, chip and tier), recorded under the date
it was read, with documented dated price changes ('stated'), announced future prices, corrections and end dates; described in
engine/rental_history.py, which also rebuilds every day's near-term rental rate from it (the ROIC history restates on it).
Backfilled on 2026-10-12 from the project's own records (archived data files of 3, 4 and 8 Sep, update.log, snapshots).
engine/collect_history.py maintains this file; it is never edited by the model.

h100_hs.stated_note: Silicon Data, 'H100 Index, May 2026' (16 Jun 2026), hyperscaler tier

ornn_index.source: https://api.ornnai.com/api/gpu/{gpu}/index-history (public, keyless, trailing three months); latest values at https://api.ornnai.com/api/daily-index/all
ornn_index.note: Ornn Compute Price Index (OCPI): a volume-weighted, winsorized average of transacted GPU rental prices across the market (actual transactions, not list prices), one global region, settled once daily by 20:00 UTC and listed on Bloomberg. The date is the settlement day. B200 is the only Blackwell index; H100 SXM and H200 are the Hopper indices. Seeded on 2026-09-08 with the API's full public window (from 2026-06-08).

token_index.note: Silicon Data LLM Token Expenditure Index family: the usage-weighted price of one million tokens across a defined LLM universe, blending active provider pricing with real consumption volume observed across multi-provider routing gateways and inference networks, normalised for input/output mix and context window, published daily. Broad market (Bloomberg SDLLMTK), open-weight models (200+ tracked) and proprietary models (120+ tracked). Units: USD per million tokens, input and output blended at the observed mix. Seeded 2026-09-09 from the public chart pages (seven daily values each); each run merges the new dates in.
token_index.unit: USD per million tokens (input + output, blended at observed mix)

quotes.note: One series per published rental quote in data/rental_rates.json (vendor, chip, tier), $/GPU-hour: 'values' = what the vendor showed on the day it was read; 'stated' = dated price changes documented by the vendor's own announcement or several reports; 'announced' = published future prices; 'corrections' = readings the collector got wrong (values hold the corrected figure); 'ended' = the vendor stopped publishing the rate. Backfilled on 2026-10-12 from the project's own records: the archived data files of 3, 4 and 8 Sep 2026, the spot readings in this file, every refresh in update.log from 17 Sep and the daily snapshots in data/snapshots/. Every run of update.py appends the day's readings.
